chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Isma‘il ibn Hammam al-Makki, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha, from his father, peace be upon him, who said:
Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said: “Regarding one upon whom walking is obligatory, when he has stoned the Jamrah, he may visit the House riding.”

key_terms.رَمَى: cast pebbles in the ritual stoning
key_terms.زَارَ: visited, here referring to going to the House for ritual visitation
key_terms.ٱلْجَمْرَةَ: the Jamrah, the stoning site in the hajj rites
key_terms.ٱلْمَشْيُ: walking as an imposed condition or obligation

ai.seo_question: Can someone obligated to walk during hajj visit the Ka'bah while riding after stoning the Jamrah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person bound by an obligation of walking during hajj. It states that after casting pebbles at the Jamrah, such a person may proceed to the House for visitation while riding.
